card.name: Numbers and units in dose rates
card.fires_on: Digits and measure units inside numeric expressions such as ages, percentages, and rates (mg/min, mL/s). It fires on the last digit or the unit just before a slash or a following unit.

modes.label: Digits in ages and percents
modes.description: A digit within an age cutoff or percentage figure.
modes.example: Of respondents with leftover drugs, 4<<4>>% kept them in case of future need

modes.label: Units in infusion rates
modes.description: A unit such as mg, mL or U right after a number in a per-time rate.
modes.example: administer at a rate of 1<< mg>> per minute

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens are mostly unrelated fragments, so there is no clear output effect.
